title: Work-in-Process (WIP)
description: The balance-sheet holding account for every open repair order's accumulated labor, parts, and sublet cost until the RO closes and the money moves to revenue and cost of sales.
x-sap-analogue: WIP account tied to the internal order settlement, cleared to zero when the order settles
x-api-note: WIP itself is not a separately named Fortellis API; it's the accounting-side mirror of the RO's open/WIP/closed status field, documented explicitly in the RO lifecycle.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
